title: Store manifest (the five stores)
description: arch §10.2: the five stores — scoped corpus repos, skill registry, personal memory store, telemetry/ledger store, role template registry. Everything file-based and open-standard; no store locked to a harness or vendor. An instance of this schema (stores/manifest.json) declares which stores exist in a deployment and where.

format.description: §10.2 'Format' column (git+markdown+PROV sidecars; git skill folders; encrypted DB w/ L3 metadata; append-only OTLP-native; git)

portability.description: §10.2 'Portability property' column (portable as repo / moves with person / exportable / provisioning unit)

path.description: Where this store lives in this deployment (fork: repo-relative path or external locator)

encrypted.description: Encryption at rest (required true for personal_memory — §10.2 store 3; enforced per-principal at FK7-pre)
